description: SwiftUI view source code for the RootCanvas component, managing the main UI layout, onboarding flow, settings, and gateway status in an iOS app.

classes.name: RootCanvas
classes.description: Main SwiftUI View managing app state, onboarding, various UI sheets, and scene behavior.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Data structure representing the state to be displayed on the home canvas.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Represents individual agent cards shown in the home canvas, indicating active or default status.

classes.name: CanvasContent
classes.description: Sub-view that displays the main content including toolbar, tap overlays, and gateway actions.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: Visual overlay effect simulating a camera flash when the nonce changes.

methods.name: startupPresentationRoute
methods.description: Determines initial app presentation flow based on connection and onboarding status.

methods.name: shouldPresentQuickSetup
methods.description: Decides if the quick setup sheet should be presented based on various flags.

methods.name: updateIdleTimer
methods.description: Enables or disables the device idle timer based on scene activity and user settings.

methods.name: updateCanvasDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates debugging info overlay on the app's main screen if debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Serializes current app state into JSON and updates the home canvas display.

methods.name: makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Creates a payload with app and gateway status, agent info for the home canvas.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentID
methods.description: Returns the current active agent ID based on app model state.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentID
methods.description: Retrieves the default agent ID set in the app model.

methods.name: homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Generates list of agent cards, marking active/default states.

methods.name: homeCanvasName
methods.description: Computes display name for an agent, fallback to ID if name is unavailable.

methods.name: homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Computes badge (emoji or initials) for an agent card.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string, returns nil if empty.

methods.name: evaluateOnboardingPresentation
methods.description: Decides whether to show onboarding or settings on launch.

methods.name: hasExistingGatewayConfig
methods.description: Checks various stored configs to determine if a gateway configuration exists.

methods.name: maybeAutoOpenSettings
methods.description: Automatically presents settings sheet if conditions match.

methods.name: maybeShowQuickSetup
methods.description: Decides if the quick setup should be presented.
